title: Chats

empty.title: Start a chat
empty.body: Pick a model and ask anything. You can keep typing while it works.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

pending.note: They reach the model together, in order, at its next step.
pending.afterStop: You stopped the turn. These messages are waiting for you.
pending.afterFailure: The turn ended early. These messages are waiting for you.

tool.undoable: This can be undone in the add-on.
tool.waiting: {{addon}} left this change waiting; it was not applied.

notes.compacted: The conversation was compacted to make room ({{before}} to {{after}} tokens).

errors.send: The message could not be sent.
errors.delete: The chat could not be deleted.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.chat: The chat and its messages are deleted for good.
confirmDelete.agent: Chats that use this agent are kept. Triggers that use it stop working.
confirmDelete.trigger: The trigger stops and its history of runs is deleted.
confirmDelete.connector: The bot stops answering, and the bot token saved with it is deleted. To set the bot up again you must enter the token again.
confirmDelete.skill: The skill file is deleted for good.
confirmDelete.mcp: The connector is deleted with its saved token, headers and environment. A saved agent that names it can no longer use it.

memoryNotice: Chats are kept in memory only. They are lost when the server restarts.

attach.busy: Files go with a message that starts a turn. Wait for this one to end or stop it.
attach.off: Files are off on this server.

skillsPage.title: Skills
skillsPage.intro: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md that tells the model how to do one kind of task. Chats list the skills they can use and the model reads one when a task matches. The nearest skill wins when two have the same name.
skillsPage.name: Name

agentsPage.title: Agents
agentsPage.intro: An agent is a saved set of instructions and tools. A chat with an agent gets only what its lists name, and only what you may use at that moment.
agentsPage.name: Name
agentsPage.grants: What a chat with this agent may use. An empty list gives nothing.
agentsPage.mcpHint: Server name from the model's MCP configuration
agentsPage.fixModel: Always use one model (otherwise you choose the model for each chat)
agentsPage.noConnectors: You have no MCP connectors yet.

triggersPage.title: Triggers
triggersPage.intro: A trigger starts a chat as you, by itself: at a time, or when a file arrives in a folder. Each run is an ordinary chat that you can open and undo.
triggersPage.name: Name
triggersPage.noAgentNote: With no agent, a run uses the model and switches of the chat that made it, and no tool that acts at once. Choose an agent to give it more.
triggersPage.proposalsNote: A proposal does nothing until you confirm it.

inbox.pushDenied: Browser notifications are blocked for this site.
inbox.pushUnavailable: This server cannot keep push subscriptions.

connectorsPage.title: Connectors
connectorsPage.intro: A connector links something to your chats. A Telegram bot lets people talk to one of your agents from Telegram. An MCP server gives your chats and agents more tools.
connectorsPage.name: Name
connectorsPage.tokenHelp: From @BotFather. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
connectorsPage.tokenSaved: Saved. Type a new token to replace it.
connectorsPage.anyone: Anyone who can message the bot
connectorsPage.anyoneWarning: Anyone who can message this bot can use this agent's tools, as you. Each person gets a conversation of their own.
connectorsPage.notifyChat: Send my notifications to this chat ID
connectorsPage.notifyHelp: Optional. A numeric Telegram chat ID.
connectorsPage.noSenders: Nobody has written to this bot yet.

conversionPage.title: Converted from the old chat
conversionPage.intro: The old chat, agents, tasks, skills and Telegram connectors were converted when this server started. Triggers and connectors are switched off until you turn them on. A chat keeps what was said, not what the model remembered.
conversionPage.notRun: No conversion has run on this server.

mcpPage.intro: An MCP server gives your chats tools to call. Your chats use the ones that are on. A saved agent uses a connector only when you pick it in its list. The server must be reachable from this machine and must use http or https; sign-in with OAuth is not supported yet, so use a token or a header.
mcpPage.name: Name
mcpPage.urlHelp: Addresses on private networks are refused unless an administrator allows them.
mcpPage.tokenHelp: Optional. Sent as an Authorization header. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
mcpPage.tokenSaved: Saved. Type a new token to replace it.
mcpPage.headersHelp: Optional. Values are kept sealed and never shown again.
mcpPage.headersSaved: Headers are saved. Add rows to replace them.
mcpPage.envHelp: Optional. Values are kept sealed and never shown again.
mcpPage.envSaved: An environment is saved. Add rows to replace it.
mcpPage.enabledHelp: Switch it on after a successful test.
mcpPage.testNoTools: Connected. The server offers no tools.
mcpPage.forbidden: MCP is not available to your account.

import.title: Servers kept in this browser
import.text: The old chat page kept these MCP servers in this browser. Import them to keep them on the server, where every browser and session can use them. They are made switched off. Their tokens and headers go to the server and are then removed from this browser.
import.done: Imported {{count}}. They are switched off: test and turn them on below.
import.left: The servers that were not imported stay in this browser.
